theory.intro: Changing how a loan is repaid changes both how long it runs and how much it costs. With otherwise unchanged loan conditions and repayments sufficient to reduce the balance, paying more each period, paying more often, or paying a lump sum can cut the balance sooner, so less interest is charged.
facts: Interest is charged on the balance owing, so lowering the balance sooner reduces interest under otherwise unchanged loan conditions.
With otherwise unchanged loan conditions and repayments sufficient to reduce the balance, a larger repayment clears the loan sooner and reduces total interest.
For equal repayments, total repaid $=$ repayment $\times$ number of repayments. Add any separate payments, including a lump sum or a different final repayment.
Fortnightly repayments of half the monthly amount are made $26$ times a year, which is more than $12$ monthly payments.
A **lump-sum payment** is a single extra amount paid off the balance; with otherwise unchanged loan conditions and regular repayments sufficient to reduce the balance, it shortens the term.
With a lump sum, the total paid is the regular repayments actually made plus the lump sum itself.
An extra payment made early reduces the balance over more remaining interest periods than the same payment made near the end, so it saves more interest under otherwise unchanged loan conditions.
If repayments do not cover the interest charged, the balance increases and the loan will not be repaid at that repayment amount.
steps: Work out the total repaid under the first option.
Work out the total repaid under the second option, adding any lump sum.
Subtract to find the saving, or subtract the amount borrowed to find the interest.

workedExamples.question_text: A reducing balance loan of $\$8000$ is fully repaid by $30$ equal monthly repayments of $\$320$. Find the total amount repaid and the total interest paid.
A loan of $\$200\,000$ can be cleared by equal monthly repayments of $\$1600$ over $20$ years, or equal fortnightly repayments of $\$800$ over $17$ years. Find the difference in total interest paid.
workedExamples.solution_text:
Monthly repayments:
$\begin{align*}\text{Total repaid} &=1600\times12\times20\\&=\$384\,000\\\text{Interest} &=384\,000-200\,000\\&=\$184\,000\end{align*}$
Fortnightly repayments:
$\begin{align*}\text{Total repaid} &=800\times26\times17\\&=\$353\,600\\\text{Interest} &=353\,600-200\,000\\&=\$153\,600\end{align*}$
$\begin{align*}\text{Interest saving} &=184\,000-153\,600\\&=\$30\,400\end{align*}$

workedExamples.question_text: A loan of $\$90\,000$ is scheduled to be cleared by equal monthly repayments of $\$800$ over $15$ years. After $4$ years, the borrower pays a lump sum of $\$20\,000$ and continues paying $\$800$ per month. The loan is cleared after a further $96$ equal monthly repayments. Find the overall saving and how many months earlier the loan is cleared.
workedExamples.solution_text:
Without the lump sum:
$\begin{align*}\text{Number of repayments} &=15\times12=180\\\text{Total repaid} &=800\times180\\&=\$144\,000\end{align*}$
With the lump sum, include repayments made before and after the extra payment:
$\begin{align*}\text{Number of repayments} &=4\times12+96\\&=144\\\text{Total repaid} &=800\times144+20\,000\\&=\$135\,200\end{align*}$
$\begin{align*}\text{Saving} &=144\,000-135\,200\\&=\$8800\\\text{Term reduction} &=180-144\\&=36\text{ months}\end{align*}$

workedExamples.question_text: A loan of $\$30\,000$ can be cleared by $90$ equal monthly repayments of $\$450$. Increasing the monthly repayment to $\$500$ clears it in $78$ equal repayments. Find the overall saving.
workedExamples.solution_text:
At $\$450$ per month:
$\begin{align*}\text{Total repaid} &=450\times90\\&=\$40\,500\end{align*}$
At $\$500$ per month:
$\begin{align*}\text{Total repaid} &=500\times78\\&=\$39\,000\end{align*}$
$\begin{align*}\text{Saving} &=40\,500-39\,000\\&=\$1500\end{align*}$

Read where each curve meets the horizontal axis. The solid blue curve gives about $110$ months; the dashed red curve gives about $50$ months.
At $\$450$ per month:
$\begin{align*}\text{Estimated total} &=450\times110\\&=\$49\,500\end{align*}$
At $\$750$ per month:
$\begin{align*}\text{Estimated total} &=750\times50\\&=\$37\,500\end{align*}$
$\begin{align*}\text{Estimated saving} &=49\,500-37\,500\\&=\$12\,000\end{align*}$

workedExamples.question_text: A reducing balance loan of $\$10\,000$ charges interest at $9\%$ p.a., compounded monthly. Repayments of $\$400$ are made at the end of each month, starting one month after borrowing. Find the balance immediately after the second repayment. Round each month's interest to the nearest cent.
workedExamples.solution_text:
$\text{Monthly rate}=\dfrac{0.09}{12}=0.0075$
Month 1:
$\begin{align*}\text{Interest} &=10\,000\times0.0075\\&=\$75.00\\\text{Ending balance} &=10\,000+75-400\\&=\$9675.00\end{align*}$
Use this ending balance as the next month's starting balance.
Month 2:
$\begin{align*}\text{Interest} &=9675\times0.0075\\&=72.5625\\&\approx\$72.56\\\text{Ending balance} &=9675+72.56-400\\&=\$9347.56\end{align*}$

foundation.question_text:
A loan of $\$5000$ is fully repaid by $24$ equal monthly repayments of $\$250$.
Find the total amount repaid.

A loan of $\$180\,000$ can be repaid monthly at $\$1450$ over $20$ years, or fortnightly at $\$725$ over $17$ years.
Which option costs less in total, and by how much?
foundation.solution_text:
Monthly: total $= 1450 \times 12 \times 20$
$= \$348\,000$
Fortnightly: total $= 725 \times 26 \times 17$
$= \$320\,450$
The fortnightly option costs less:
$348\,000 - 320\,450 = \$27\,550$ less

foundation.question_text:
A loan of $\$84\,000$ is to be repaid by equal monthly repayments of $\$700$ over $15$ years.
After $3$ years the borrower pays a lump sum of $\$15\,000$ and continues paying $\$700$ per month. The loan is cleared after a further $108$ equal monthly repayments.
How much less is paid overall?
foundation.solution_text:
Without the lump sum: total $= 700 \times 12 \times 15 = \$126\,000$
With the lump sum: number of repayments $= 3 \times 12 + 108 = 144$
Total $= 700 \times 144 + 15\,000 = \$115\,800$
Saving $= 126\,000 - 115\,800 = \$10\,200$

development.question_text:
A loan of $\$320\,000$ can be repaid monthly at $\$2210$ over $30$ years, or fortnightly at $\$1105$ over $26$ years.
Find the difference in the total interest paid under the two methods.

A loan of $\$280\,000$ is repaid at $\$1650$ per month over $25$ years.
After $8$ years the borrower pays a lump sum of $\$50\,000$, and the loan is then fully repaid after a further $156$ monthly repayments.
How much less is paid overall?
development.solution_text:
Without the lump sum: total $= 1650 \times 12 \times 25$
$= \$495\,000$
With the lump sum:
Number of repayments $= 8 \times 12 + 156 = 252$
Total $= 1650 \times 252 + 50\,000$
$= 415\,800 + 50\,000$
$= \$465\,800$
Difference $= 495\,000 - 465\,800$
$= \$29\,200$

development.question_text:
A loan of $\$250\,000$ is due to be repaid at $\$1580$ per month over $25$ years.
Instead the borrower pays $\$1700$ per month, clearing the loan in $254$ months.
How much is saved in total?

development.solution_text:
At $\$800$ per month the curve reaches zero at about $140$ months.
Total $= 800 \times 140 = \$112\,000$
At $\$1200$ per month the curve reaches zero at about $70$ months.
Total $= 1200 \times 70 = \$84\,000$
Difference $= 112\,000 - 84\,000$
$= \$28\,000$ less

development.question_text:
A loan of $\$200\,000$ is repaid at $\$1400$ per month over $30$ years.
After $12$ years a lump sum of $\$40\,000$ is paid, and the loan is fully repaid after a further $132$ monthly repayments.
Find the total saving.
development.solution_text:
Without the lump sum: total $= 1400 \times 12 \times 30$
$= \$504\,000$
With the lump sum:
Number of repayments $= 12 \times 12 + 132 = 276$
Total $= 1400 \times 276 + 40\,000$
$= 386\,400 + 40\,000$
$= \$426\,400$
Saving $= 504\,000 - 426\,400$
$= \$77\,600$

mastery.question_text:
A loan of $\$400\,000$ is to be repaid by equal monthly repayments of $\$2650$ over $30$ years.
After $10$ years the borrower pays a lump sum of $\$60\,000$ and continues paying $\$2650$ per month. The loan is cleared after a further $172$ equal monthly repayments.
How much less is paid in total?
mastery.solution_text:
Without the lump sum: total $= 2650 \times 12 \times 30 = \$954\,000$
With the lump sum: number of repayments $= 10 \times 12 + 172 = 292$
Total $= 2650 \times 292 + 60\,000 = \$833\,800$
Saving $= 954\,000 - 833\,800 = \$120\,200$

mastery.question_text:
A loan of $\$240\,000$ can be repaid monthly at $\$1718$ over $20$ years, or fortnightly at $\$859$ over $17$ years and $6$ months.
Find the difference in the total interest paid.

A loan of $\$150\,000$ was to be repaid at $\$1250$ per month over $20$ years.
After $5$ years a lump sum of $\$30\,000$ is paid, and the loan is cleared by a further $122$ monthly repayments.
Find the total saving and the number of months by which the term is shortened.
mastery.solution_text:
Without the lump sum: total $= 1250 \times 12 \times 20$
$= \$300\,000$ over $240$ months
With the lump sum:
Number of repayments $= 5 \times 12 + 122 = 182$
Total $= 1250 \times 182 + 30\,000$
$= 227\,500 + 30\,000$
$= \$257\,500$
Saving $= 300\,000 - 257\,500 = \$42\,500$
Term shortened by $240 - 182 = 58$ months
